many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

inp=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 input']); out=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print('row diffs vs base cycle:')
for i in range(H):
    o=out[i]; base=S
    # check if o is some roll of S plus inserted dup
    # find best match
    cands={}
    for s in range(6):
        r=[base[(j+s)%6] for j in range(W)]
        n=sum(1 for j in range(W) if o[j]==r[j])
        cands[s]=n
    # also insert-one-dup into best roll
    sbest=max(cands,key=cands.get)
    r=[base[(j+sbest)%6] for j in range(W)]
    # try inserting dup of r[k] at each k
    best=-1;k=-1
    for ins in range(W):
        r2=r[:ins]+[r[ins]]+r[ins+1:]
        n=sum(1 for j in range(W) if o[j]==r2[j])
        if n>best: best=n;k=ins
    print(i,'roll',sbest,cands[sbest],'dup@',k, 'score',best,'/',W)

import numpy as np
def row_phase(cells):
    # fit v=(c+s)%9+1, choose s by majority vote among nonzero cells
    ps=[(int(v)-1-c)%9 for c,v in enumerate(cells) if v!=0]
    from collections import Counter
    return Counter(ps).most_common(1)[0][0], {p:sum(1 for x in ps if x==p) for p in range(9)}

    print(r, 'zeros', [c for c in range(23) if T[r,c]==0], 'phase',ph,'mismatches',mism)
